headline: Texas mail ballot ID rules back in effect
standfirst: A federal appeals court has reinstated identity requirements for mail-in voting in Texas.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: A federal appeals court has reinstated strict ID requirements for mail-in ballots in Texas.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The court overturned a lower ruling that had blocked these specific identification rules.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: This decision changes how voters verify their identity when casting ballots by mail in Texas.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Look for updates on how this impacts upcoming election procedures and voter compliance.

caption:
A federal appeals court has reinstated identity requirements for mail-in voting in Texas.

The ruling reverses a previous block on these specific identification rules. This change directly affects the verification process for mail-in ballots across the state.
